optimization_evidence.interpretation: Fixed512 updates do not establish matched convergence. Report actual late objective trends; ranking uses train2–5s and is distinct from fit0.5s. No claim of model-family inadequacy or representation-error lower bound.

warnings: Selection uses train only. Synthetic val evaluates three selected models only; it did not compare all18 candidates.
Numerical intervals are discretization-error bounds, not statistical confidence intervals.
A different selected expression does not prove unique latent coordinates, genuine device mechanism, or falsify the teacher family.
New growth-controlled grammar and no early elimination are combined design changes; this study cannot attribute differences to one alone.
Read-only CPU deserialization inspected recorded traces/Adam counts; no extra optimizer update, data generation or prediction was run.
extraction_kind: Read-only post-completion factual extraction; existing JSON/byte hashes and CPU-only reads of recorded training states. Not a formal scientific run, qualification rerun or evaluation.

extraction_accounting.note: The tool returned wall timing but this read-only extractor did not record its own OS PID/creation identity or CPU counters. Do not invent those values or include this timing in formal9216-update native job cost.
